spans.s: प्रदक्षिण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Being or placed on the right; 2. respectful, reverential; 3. auspicious, favourable.

प्रदक्षिण (II) m.n. Salutation by turning round anyone so that the right side is towards the person saluted, K.S.vii.79.(प्रदक्षिणम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) from left to right; (2) turning the right side towards; (3) in a southern direction. प्रदक्षिणीकृ ‘to go round,’ प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य हुतं हुताशम् R.ii.71.)
प्रदक्षिण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Being or placed on the right; 2. respectful, reverential; 3. auspicious, favourable.
प्रदक्षिण-अर्चिस् a. having the flames turned towards the right, R.iii.14.
प्रदक्षिण-क्रिया f. turning the right side towards anyone as a mark of respect, R.i.76.
प्रदक्षिण-पट्टिका f. a courtyard.

प्रदर m. 1. A fracture, a crack, a crevice; 2. the dispersion of an army; 3. an arrow; 4. a particular disease of women.
प्रदर्प m. Pride, arrogance.
प्रदर्श m. 1. Look, appearance; 2. direction.
प्रदर्शन n. 1. Look, appearance, aspect; 2. manifesting, displaying, bringing to light; 3. teaching, explaining; 4. an example.
प्रदर्शित a. (f. ता) 1. Manifested, exhibited, evinced; 2. made known; 3. taught, explained.

प्रदल m. An arrow.
प्रदव m. Burning, inflaming.
प्रदातृ m. 1. A giver, a donor; 2. one who gives a daughter in marriage; 3. an epithet of Indra.
प्रदान n. 1. Bestowing, granting, offering (as in वरप्रदान); 2. instructing, teaching (as in वेदप्रदान); 3. giving away in marriage; 4. a gift, a present; 5. a goad.
प्रदान-शूर m. a very liberal man.
प्रदानक n. An offering, a donation.
प्रदाय n. A present.
प्रदि m. A present.
प्रदि m. A present.
प्रदिग्ध (I) a. (f. ग्धा) Besmeared, anointed.
प्रदिग्ध (II) n. Fried meat.
प्रदिग्ध (I) a. (f. ग्धा) Besmeared, anointed.
प्रदिश् f. 1. Direction, order, command; 2. an intermediate quarter of the compass, (e.g. आग्नेयी).
प्रदिष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Pointed out, shown; 2. ordained, appointed, R.ii.39.
प्रदिष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Pointed out, shown; 2. ordained, appointed, R.ii.39.
प्रदीप m. 1. A light, a lamp, R.ii.24, xvi.4, K.S.i.10; 2. (at the end of titles of works) elucidation, (e.g. काव्यप्रदीप).
प्रदीपन (I) n. The act of lighting or kindling.
प्रदीपन (II) m. A kind of mineral poison.
प्रदीप्त a. (f. प्ता) 1. Lighted, kindled, illuminated; 2. blazing, shining; 3. excited, stimulated (as hunger).
प्रदीप्त a. (f. प्ता) 1. Lighted, kindled, illuminated; 2. blazing, shining; 3. excited, stimulated (as hunger).
प्रदुष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Wicked, bad, sinful; 2. wanton, licentious.
प्रदुष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Wicked, bad, sinful; 2. wanton, licentious.
प्रदूषित a. (f. ता) 1. Spoiled, corrupted, vitiated; 2. polluted, defiled.
प्रदूषित a. (f. ता) 1. Spoiled, corrupted, vitiated; 2. polluted, defiled.
प्रदेश m. 1. A place, a spot, a region, R.v.60; 2. a country, a district, K.S.v.45; 3. a span measured from the tip of the thumb to the end of the fore-finger; 4. decision, determination; 5. a wall.
प्रादेश m. 1. The span of the thumb and forefinger; 2. place, spot.
प्रदेशन n. 1. Advice, instruction; 2. a gift, a present, an offering.
प्रादेशन n. A gift.

प्रादेशिनी f. The forefinger.
प्रदेह m. 1. Applying a plaster; 2. a plaster.
प्रदोष m. 1. Fault, defect; 2. a disordered condition; 3. night-fall, the first part of the night, कामं प्रदोषतिमिरेण न दृश्यते त्वम् Mrich.i., K.S.v.44, R.i.93.
प्रादोष a. (f. षी) Relating to the evening.
प्रदोष-काल ind. evening time.
प्रदोष-तिमिर n. the dusk of early night.
प्रदोह m. Milking.
प्रद्युम्न m. An epithet of the god of love.
प्रद्योत m. 1. Lighting, illumining; 2. light, lustre; 3. a ray of light; 4. name of a king of Ujjayinī, प्रद्योतस्य प्रियदुहितरं वत्सराजोऽत्र जह्रे Megh.i. (considered to be spurious by Mall.)
प्रद्योतन (I) m. The sun.
प्रद्योतन (II) n. Blazing, shining.
प्रद्रव m. 1. Running away, retreat, escape; 2. running, going fast.
प्रद्रव m. 1. Running away, retreat, escape; 2. running, going fast.
प्रद्वार् f. A place near a door.
प्रद्वार n. A place near a door.
प्रद्वेष m. Dislike, aversion, hatred.
प्रद्वेषण n. Dislike, aversion, hatred.
प्रादक्षिण्य n. Circumambulation by starting from the left and going round to the right.
प्रादुस् ind. (a particle used in combination with अस्, कृ or भू) Visibly, in sight, evidently, manifestly, R.xi.15, M.i.6. See under अस्, कृ and भू.
प्रादुष्करण n. the making visible, manifestation.
प्रादुर्भाव m. 1. arising, coming into existence; 2. the becoming visible; 3. the becoming audible; 4. the appearance of a deity on earth.
